text_blocks.snippet: Nutrition therapy for Crohn's disease aims to manage symptoms, induce remission, and promote healing through dietary modifications and nutritional support. It involves strategies like enteral nutrition (using formulas) and dietary adjustments to minimize inflammation and nutrient deficiencies.

list.title: Enteral Nutrition (EN):
list.snippet: This involves using a liquid formula, either exclusively (EEN) or partially (PEN), to provide nutrition.
Exclusive Enteral Nutrition (EEN): The patient consumes only formula, with water and some allowed liquids, for all meals. EEN has been shown to induce remission in children with Crohn's.
Partial Enteral Nutrition (PEN): A combination of formula and some regular food is consumed.
